primary_penal_code: Theft Act 1968 & Offences Against Person Act 1861

statutes.act_name: Divorce, Dissolution and Separation Act 2020 & Matrimonial Causes Act 1973
statutes.title: No-Fault Divorce & Irretrievable Breakdown of Marriage
statutes.description: Provides for no-fault divorce in England & Wales where either spouse or both jointly file a statement of irretrievable breakdown of marriage without needing to prove fault, adultery, or separation period. Governs Decree Nisi, Decree Absolute, and financial remedies.

statutes.act_name: Consumer Rights Act 2015 & Donoghue v Stevenson
statutes.title: Goods to be of Satisfactory Quality & Duty of Care for Defective Products
statutes.description: Requirement that goods sold (including food and beverages, ginger beer) must be of satisfactory quality, fit for purpose, and safe, establishing manufacturer duty of care for foreign objects or decomposition causing injury.
statutes.penalty: Refund, repair, replacement, and common law damages for gastroenteritis and personal injury.

statutes.title: Data Protection Violations & Network Breach Security
statutes.description: Failure of data controllers and processors to implement appropriate technical measures to prevent unauthorized access, downloading, or hacking of personal data and financial records.
statutes.penalty: Administrative fines up to £17.5M or 4% of global turnover, and statutory compensation.

statutes.act_name: Consumer Rights Act 2015 & Fisher v Bell Principles
statutes.title: Invitation to Treat vs Binding Offer in Retail Pricing
statutes.description: Item catalogs, shop displays, and price labels are invitations to treat rather than binding contract offers; retailer is not compelled to sell if pricing error occurs prior to acceptance at till.
statutes.penalty: No forced sale; catalog pricing disclaimer enforced.

statutes.title: Occupier Common Duty of Care to Visitors
statutes.description: Duty of premises occupier or hotel to take reasonable care to ensure visitors are safe, prohibiting exposed electrical cables or hazardous dim lighting causing trips and falls.
statutes.penalty: Damages for physical injury, pain, suffering, and medical expenses.

statutes.title: Pregnancy Discrimination & Automatic Unfair Dismissal
statutes.description: Unlawful discrimination and automatic unfair dismissal of employee due to pregnancy, maternity leave notification, or related medical absence.
statutes.penalty: Employment tribunal reinstatement, re-engagement, and uncapped injury to feelings compensation.

statutes.title: Statutory Nuisance & Sub-Woofer Noise Pollution
statutes.description: Noise emitted from premises (such as continuous midnight sub-woofer bass tracks) so as to be prejudicial to health or a statutory private nuisance.
statutes.penalty: Abatement notice, criminal prosecution for non-compliance, and fine up to £5,000.

statutes.act_name: Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990
statutes.title: Unauthorized Demolition or Alteration of Listed Building
statutes.description: Executing unauthorized works for demolition, alteration, or extension of Grade-I or Grade-II listed heritage buildings affecting special architectural character.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 years, unlimited fine, and enforcement order to restore building.

statutes.title: Dangerous Driving & Mobile Phone Usage in School Zone
statutes.description: Driving a mechanically propelled vehicle dangerously on a road (such as 50mph in a 20mph school zone) or using a handheld mobile phone while driving.
statutes.penalty: Mandatory driving disqualification, up to 2 years imprisonment, fine, and penalty points.

statutes.title: Criminal Liability for Piracy Server & Commercial Infringement
statutes.description: Making, distributing, or hosting unauthorized file servers for downloading pirated software, media, or copyrighted digital material without paying royalties.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 10 years, unlimited fine, and asset forfeiture.

statutes.title: Requirement of Serious Harm for Online Defamation
statutes.description: Publishing false defamatory statements on social media or online platforms causing or likely to cause serious harm to personal or commercial reputation.
statutes.penalty: Damages, injunction prohibiting republishing, and mandatory apology publication.

statutes.act_name: Protection from Eviction Act 1977 & Covenant of Quiet Enjoyment
statutes.title: Unlawful Entry & Harassment of Residential Tenant
statutes.description: Unlawful entry into tenant's private rented room using master keys without emergency or prior written notice, constituting breach of quiet enjoyment and harassment.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 years, fine, and civil damages for harassment.

statutes.act_name: Criminal Law Act 1977 & Malicious Communications Act 1988
statutes.title: Bomb Hoax & False Threat Reports
statutes.description: Placing or communicating false reports that an explosive device or bomb is present in public transport, subway stations, or public places.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine.

statutes.title: Highway Authority Duty to Maintain Public Road & Potholes
statutes.description: Failure of local highway authority to maintain public roads in safe condition, causing pothole accidents and injuries to cyclists or motorists.
statutes.penalty: Damages for physical injury, loss of earnings, and property damage.

statutes.act_name: Proceeds of Crime Act 2002 & Money Laundering Regulations 2017
statutes.title: Failure to Disclose Suspicious Money Laundering Activity
statutes.description: Failure of financial institution or bank employee to submit Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) when handling unverified multi-million cash deposits.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 5 years, unlimited fine, and regulatory sanction.

statutes.title: Adverse Possession of Unregistered or Registered Land
statutes.description: Uninterrupted adverse possession and occupation of land or farmland for 10 to 12 years without landlord consent or rent payment.
statutes.penalty: Registration of title ownership subject to statutory conditions.

statutes.title: Limits on Police Detention Without Charge
statutes.description: Maximum 24-hour police detention limit without charge, requiring senior officer or Magistrates' Court warrant extension for detention up to 36 or 96 hours.
statutes.penalty: Immediate release of detainee and civil claim for unlawful imprisonment.

statutes.act_name: Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008 & Human Medicines Regulations 2012
statutes.title: Unfair Trading, False Cure Guarantees & Unapproved Medicines
statutes.description: Marketing herbal solutions, medical treatments, or health products with false claims of clinically proven cures for diabetes without medical testing or licensing.
statutes.penalty: Fine, prohibition order, and criminal prosecution for misleading commercial practices.

statutes.title: Endangering Safety of Aircraft & Illegal Drone Operation
statutes.description: Flying unmanned aircraft, drones, or 2kg devices through active flight paths or near Heathrow Airport endangering aircraft safety.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 5 years, fine, and drone seizure.

statutes.title: Burglary & House-Breaking Offences
statutes.description: Entering any building or part of a building as a trespasser with intent to steal electronic devices, cash, jewelry or inflict grievous bodily harm.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 14 years for dwelling burglary on indictment

statutes.title: Basic Definition and Offence of Theft
statutes.description: A person is guilty of theft if he dishonestly appropriates property belonging to another with the intention of permanently depriving the other of it.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years

statutes.title: Fraud by False Representation & Cyber Phishing
statutes.description: Dishonestly making a false representation with intent to make a gain or cause loss to another (online scams, OTP phishing, WhatsApp fraud).
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 10 years on indictment

statutes.title: Right Not to be Unfairly Dismissed & Notice Requirements
statutes.description: An employee has the right not to be unfairly dismissed by his employer without statutory notice or disciplinary procedure after qualifying service period.
statutes.penalty: Employment Tribunal reinstatement order or statutory compensation

statutes.title: Burglary & House-Breaking Offences
statutes.description: Entering any building or part of a building as a trespasser with intent to steal property, cash, jewelry or inflict grievous bodily harm.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 14 years for dwelling burglary on indictment

statutes.title: Basic Definition and Offence of Theft
statutes.description: A person is guilty of theft if he dishonestly appropriates property belonging to another with the intention of permanently depriving the other of it.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years

statutes.title: Robbery with Threat or Use of Force
statutes.description: Stealing with the use of force or putting any person in fear of being subjected to force immediately before or at the time of theft.
statutes.penalty: Life imprisonment or discretionary term on indictment

statutes.title: Fraud by False Representation & Cyber Phishing
statutes.description: Dishonestly making a false representation with intent to make a gain or cause loss to another (online scams, OTP phishing, WhatsApp fraud, fake investments).
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 10 years on indictment or fine

statutes.title: Right Not to be Unfairly Dismissed & Fair Reasons for Dismissal
statutes.description: An employee has the right not to be unfairly dismissed without fair statutory reason (conduct, capability, redundancy) or without following ACAS disciplinary procedures.
statutes.penalty: Employment Tribunal order for reinstatement or compensatory award up to statutory cap

statutes.title: Statutory Minimum Notice Period & Protection from Unlawful Wage Deductions
statutes.description: Mandatory minimum statutory notice required for termination based on years of service and prohibition of unauthorized deductions from salary or final pay.
statutes.penalty: Payment of notice pay arrears and tribunal compensation

statutes.title: Pregnancy, Maternity & Protected Characteristic Discrimination
statutes.description: Unlawful discrimination or dismissal of an employee due to pregnancy, maternity leave, race, religion, sex, disability, or gender reassignment.
statutes.penalty: Uncapped compensatory damages for financial loss and injury to feelings in Employment Tribunal

statutes.act_name: Divorce, Dissolution and Separation Act 2020 & Matrimonial Causes Act 1973
statutes.title: No-Fault Mutual Divorce & Irretrievable Breakdown of Marriage
statutes.description: Application for divorce or dissolution based solely on statement of irretrievable breakdown without necessity of proving adultery, unreasonable behaviour, or separation periods.
statutes.penalty: Conditional Order (Decree Nisi) and Final Order (Decree Absolute) of Divorce

statutes.title: Goods of Satisfactory Quality & 30-Day Early Right to Reject for Full Refund
statutes.description: Every contract to supply goods includes a term that goods must be of satisfactory quality, fit for purpose, and as described. Consumer has a statutory 30-day right to reject defective goods for 100% refund.
statutes.penalty: Full refund, repair, replacement, or price reduction damages

statutes.act_name: Protection from Eviction Act 1977 & Housing Act 1988
statutes.title: Unlawful Eviction, Changing Locks & Residential Tenant Harassment
statutes.description: Landlord or agent unlawfully depriving a residential occupier of access by changing locks, cutting utilities, or intimidation without a valid County Court possession order.
statutes.penalty: Criminal prosecution with fine/imprisonment and civil statutory damages under Sections 27/28 of Housing Act 1988

statutes.title: Requirement of Serious Harm for Online & Print Defamation
statutes.description: A statement is not defamatory unless its publication has caused or is likely to cause serious harm to the reputation of the claimant or serious financial loss to a commercial body.
statutes.penalty: High Court injunction, damages for distress and reputational harm, and publication of summary judgment

statutes.title: Assault Occasioning Actual Bodily Harm (ABH) & Unlawful Wounding
statutes.description: Intentionally or recklessly inflicting bodily harm, bruises, cuts, fractures or psychiatric injury on another person without lawful justification.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 5 years on indictment

statutes.title: Dangerous Driving & Careless or Inconsiderate Driving
statutes.description: Driving a mechanically propelled vehicle on a public road in a manner that falls far below what would be expected of a competent and careful driver.
statutes.penalty: Mandatory disqualification, fine, and imprisonment up to 2 years (or up to life for causing death by dangerous driving)
